metadata.title: CUBiO 3D Memory Studio — Experimental Fractal-VSSD Data Bundle
metadata.theoretical_disclaimer: M^2 = (4/alpha')(N - a0) and T = 7.36e-51 are theoretical toy models/experimental parameters only; they do not physically describe hardware storage.

catalog.name: Constant 0x00 Buffer (64 KB)
catalog.description: Uniform byte sequence with minimal Kolmogorov complexity.

catalog.name: Cyclic 16-Byte Waveform (64 KB)
catalog.description: Cyclic 16-byte harmonic period repeating across 4,096 cycles.

catalog.name: Arithmetic Modular Ramp (64 KB)
catalog.description: Linear ramp with constant first difference modulo 256.

catalog.name: Deterministic LCG PRNG Stream (64 KB)
catalog.description: Pseudo-random stream synthesized from single 32-bit seed (seed=369).

catalog.name: Run-Length Sequence Runs (64 KB)
catalog.description: Long contiguous runs of identical byte clusters.

catalog.name: 100% Duplicate 64KB Blocks (1 MB)
catalog.description: Sixteen identical 64 KB blocks forming 1 MB payload.

catalog.name: 75% Duplicate Blocks (256 KB)
catalog.description: Four 64 KB blocks with three repeated blocks (75% redundancy).

catalog.name: Cryptographic Entropy Control (64 KB)
catalog.description: Incompressible high-entropy data triggering honest literal fallback.
